statement: Royal Guardian meta has solidified and optimal routes through worlds 1-3 are now figured out; iOS bug at launch benefited frontrunners.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Nothing has really changed in world 1 except understanding of expanded barracks advanced logistics and greater education.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Typically don't go past level 3 expanded barracks except on edge nodes leading to high priority targets.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Push expanded barracks further on slitty ledges? outpost the outpost where branches end and tucked away outpost.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Put remaining points into advanced logistics but don't completely neglect greater education; it should be somewhat higher.

creator: pulseidle

statement: On edge nodes about one greater education buy equal to one expanded barracks buy is fine.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Spam greater education on everything else because it feeds global decree; each outpost level gives all outposts extra collection rate.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Global decree gives each outpost level extra collection rate to all outposts; he has about 26.5k from it.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Collection rate is so strong that everything clears within seconds of reset; combined with global decree gets bonkers into trillions.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Two global decrees exist (one RG one O) both named the same and both very strong; getting them up matters a lot.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Progress world 1 linearly snaking through all of it then up the tree; send militia into the mines.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Sewer rat node is kind of terrible because it links to nothing important and the berry node is easy.

creator: pulseidle
statement: World 1 is hard to brick; don't think too hard even if you spammed barracks or advanced logistics on center nodes.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Even with points invested in advanced logistics early just move over to greater education and you'll be fine.

creator: pulseidle
statement: World 2 order: Sandy then Mimics then jump to Sand Castle (good mob density) then Tyson's and Snelby; roughly Snelby Tyson's Sand Castle.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Snelby's final copper resource node is a fat node to get farming as soon as possible.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Send militia down toward the port; edge nodes are prime candidates for glorify from orbit shop and commander placement.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Stop expanded barracks at 3 or 4 on world 2 edge nodes then advanced logistics since it is a true multiplier on collection rate.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Edge node optimization isn't strictly necessary given how good global decrees are; efficient but won't make or break progression.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Use middle nodes as greater education fodder; once expanded barracks hits 3 on those nodes stop and move to greater education.

creator: pulseidle
statement: World 3 order: Sheepy and Frostflake first then Mammoths then Quenchi; those four nodes let you access the entire map.

creator: pulseidle
statement: With about three barracks upgrades and guards you reach everything; those four nodes are prime glorify and commander targets.

creator: pulseidle
statement: After the four key nodes get militias to do the rest of world 3; move active RG to orbit farming on beans.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Expanded barracks level 2-3 is the sweet spot especially for center nodes then go to logistics or greater education.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Commanders generally go in same places you prioritize glorifies.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Surveyors go to intel rank 15 taking 1-2 days with 3-4 units then swap to trading for the rest of time.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Surveyor swap seems to work retroactively; exp sources on outposts affect everything including commanders so boosting them speeds command.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Not yet time to farm parchment from rats; anti-rodent power moves not high enough; Pluto prosperous chances slim (frontrunners at 8).

creator: pulseidle
statement: Parchment chance is 1 in 1000 so hours of sitting gives few levels on Pluto prosperous; not efficient yet.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Beans is the solidified orb farming map; endgamers get 5-7k orb on reset and about 5k otherwise.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Bargain is amazing; glorification necessary; hydration and talented minor; full clear bad; parchment too expensive; connection range not needed.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Care less about strong rank than originally; orbit shop priorities otherwise little changed.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Bargain is where it's at then some intervene; buy emulsion when it doesn't drain the bank; he'd rather add bargain and gamble glorification.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Marble was fixed; worlds 2 and 3 too slow for marble so sit in world 1 on beans.

statement: Beans gives marble statues and statue levels from emulsion and zenith clusters; farming them is better than before the accidental nerf.

creator: pulseidle
statement: With active DK just farm beans; maybe spend a day or two on drop rate from AC crystal first.

statement: Pages talent only works on the RG it's on; put it on second RG farming Cavern 4 getting stacks of 50 daily.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Wants 100% extra chapter pages then more on Overstem then Decay Surrounds then Sunken Plunder and Prime Evil.

statement: Amber Horde will be good: stamina bad but exp great; Grand Discovery drop rate is great at 5% per point.

statement: Maxed grand discovery gives about 500 extra drop rate but only works on the RG it is on.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Second character can put little into Castle Conamine as collection rate no longer a problem.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Guardian Disciple is the best talent on the page; max it.

statement: Regal intervention deserves a little; definitely one point in the super talent; chance for extra regal mobs boosts orb gains.

creator: pulseidle
statement: Put some points into orb of various similitude but secondary to little orlets; get little orlets to about 50-70%.

statement: Industrial politics only if hurting for resource collection; do it on second RG.

statement: Warbound politics is good if still clearing and needing pushing power; gets to 5-6x as a true multiplier.

statement: Aesthetic politics works again and is how you get marble; put it on second RG.

statement: Marble meta setup: second RG on aesthetic politics; primary RG on disciple blitz various similitudes and regal intervention.

statement: Focus glorify on edge nodes and do a few others so you can go deeper on greater education; don't go as hard as he did.
